Parse a tagged concept-ids string into one row per set

Source: R/parsePersonCountsConceptIds.R
dot-parsePersonCountsConceptIds.Rd

Parses a comma-separated list of tagged concept references, one row per token, into the (concept id, matched column, expand-descendants) triple each tag encodes. Tag grammar: <conceptId><S|M><D?> — S matches concept_id, M matches maps_to_concept_id; a trailing D expands the set to the concept and all its descendants instead of the code alone. Shared by getPersonCountsUpset() and getPersonCountsFilters().

.parsePersonCountsConceptIds(conceptIdsString)

Arguments

conceptIdsString

Comma-separated tagged concept ids, e.g. "317009S,4191479SD,2000403993M,2000403993MD".

Value

A tibble of token, concept_id, column ("concept_id"/"maps_to_concept_id"), expand_descendants (logical).
